connection.notification_capabilities: Exact per-connection optOutNotificationMethods; reconnect replaces the live delivery target without starting another worker.

command_visibility.stock_frontend_limit: codex-cli 0.163.0 has no remote slash-command allowlist; fixed unsupported commands remain client-visible and are rejected without execution
command_visibility.permission_meaning: Wire compatibility only. Registry grants, owner policy and runtime isolation remain authoritative.

agent_projection.independent_agent_task: separate Registry and PetriNet; never a subagent thread
agent_projection.subagent_thread_spawn: not advertised until a truthful parent-owned delegation bridge exists

verification.policy: Validation results belong to the exact reviewed source and locally recorded test artifacts; no static status is a runtime certification.

candidate-0.167.0: Reconnect keeps one waiter and routes terminal events to the current connection.
Startup empty turnId maps to the existing RPNH interrupt path; stale nonempty IDs fail.
Live resume replays the observed turn ID without admission, execution or reconciliation.
Active steer rejects explicitly; completed-turn retry uses ordinary turn/start.
Client message receipts and exact notification opt-outs remain presentation-only.

unsupported_methods.thread/attachment/*: No Registry-backed delivery exists. Requests fail explicitly; historical UI metadata is preserved but not advertised or executed.
unsupported_methods.skills/config/write: Native RPNH plugins are not Codex backend skills.
unsupported_methods.mcpServer/*: No frontend-owned MCP execution or authentication.
unsupported_methods.process/*: No execution outside the RPNH Registry/Petri gateway.
unsupported_methods.turn/steer: No same-turn input injection or server queue. Active requests fail explicitly without admission; an already completed turn uses the native no-active-turn race response so the TUI can submit a new turn.

method_classes.meaning: Empty discovery is a compatibility response, not an installed capability.

history_projection.source: existing owner-bound MainThreadRegistry fixed canonical cut
history_projection.wire_thread_id: UUID rendering of the unchanged stable session identity
history_projection.safe_items: committed original user text and safe main decision text only
history_projection.live_resume: Replay the existing observed in-progress turn ID as turn/started; committed history and cursors remain bound to the native fixed cut.
history_projection.submission_receipts: Echo clientUserMessageId as clientId on live userMessage receipts only; it is never persisted as execution or history authority.

compatibility_profiles.selection: Explicit local keyword only. No environment, version-range, initialize-selected or automatic candidate selection.
